major_concerns: Verifier coverage may be lossy (false positives/negatives) for nuanced semantics (BGP, ACL corner cases).
Synthetic task design and vendor-syntax emulation risk poor external validity versus real multi‑vendor networks.
Mapping LLM output→verifier input (parsing/translation) is a brittle step that can dominate measured failures.
Potential unintended dataset bias toward verifier-checkable properties, missing other operational risks.
required_design_repairs: Specify exact verifier(s) (versions/configs) and formal input mapping; include validation of mapping (examples + failure modes).
Define vendor-syntax specification and realism criteria; publish transformation rules and example device models.
Pre-register baseline generation procedure and gold-reference construction (who/what produces gold configs).
Add protocol for measuring and reporting verifier false-positive/false-negative rates (oracle or manual adjudication on a sampled subset).

major_concerns: Relies on NetConfig-Semantic (or equivalent) — any bias there propagates to iteration conclusions.
Repair signal quality (counterexamples) is underspecified and may leak verifier internals, altering LLM behavior.
Findings may be tightly coupled to the chosen LLM and prompt templates (limited generality).
Retry and seed policies need strict preregistration to avoid post-hoc run selection.
required_design_repairs: Define structured counterexample format (schema) and standardize feedback templates; justify non-leaking design.
Pre-register exact repair prompts, stopping rules, random-seed policy, and retry policy.
Include multi-model sensitivity checks or clearly bound generalization claims to the tested model.
Add manual adjudication on a random subset to validate verifier→repair effectiveness and measure false-repair corrections.

major_concerns: Simulator fidelity and its mapping to real deployment risk is a major threat to external validity.
Agent implementations can diverge; ensuring behavioural parity between Agent-only and Agent+Verifier pipelines is nontrivial.
False-positive blocking by the verifier may inflate human-review counts and affect measured trade-offs.
Measurement of 'unsafe deployment' needs an explicit, operational definition tied to verifier capabilities.
required_design_repairs: Validate simulator against at least one established network simulator or small real-device trace to justify fidelity.
Lock agent policy and randomness; document agent architecture and seed controls to ensure comparable behavior across pipelines.
Predefine and disclose precise operational definition of 'unsafe deployment' and adjudication procedure for disputed cases.
Include sensitivity analyses showing results stability under alternative verifier strictness thresholds.

major_concerns: Hallucination corpus is synthetic; representativeness of real agent hallucinations is uncertain.
Defining ground-truth labels for hallucination vs benign ambiguous traces can be subjective.
Monitors may introduce latency or operational overhead not accounted for in detection-only metrics.
Adversarial variants may evade detectors; robustness evaluation must be rigorous.
required_design_repairs: Describe corpus construction and labeling protocol; include inter-annotator agreement and examples.
Measure monitor runtime/latency and report trade-offs for realistic pipeline integration.
Specify adversarial perturbation generation method and include baseline real-agent trace evaluation (if available).
Calibrate and preregister monitor thresholds; report sensitivity analyses for threshold choices.
